prompt:
Create ONE finished tarot illustration, portrait 2:3 (1024x1536), edge-to-edge full bleed. Use the first reference images strictly for the ACTUAL Dragon Quest character identities, hairstyles, faces and costume colors. Some official references contain sepia portraits, page text, frames or UI: use only the solid colored character design, never reproduce reference text/layout. The LAST reference is an already accepted DQIII Fool card used ONLY for matching the deck's bold clean black linework, classic Toriyama Dragon Quest cel coloring, subtly hand-painted paper texture, warm ivory highlights, rich clear blue/turquoise atmosphere, greens and warm ochre accents; do NOT reuse its hero or composition. Actual named characters, not generic original adventurers. Large legible silhouettes and faces; scene thoughtfully composed for a phone screen. Character identity and correct suit-object count matter more than elaborate detail.
Character reference 1: DQ VI Carver: very muscular stocky man, pink-purple MOHAWK, short blue-gray vest over bare chest, orange shoulder sash, green belt and greenish shorts, green leg wraps. Foreground character only.
Character reference 2: DQ IV Ragnar: mature soldier with blue mustache, bright pink plumed helmet and pink armor, red cape, silver shoulder plates.
Character reference 3: DQ VIII Yangus: short very stocky broad man with spiked horn-like metal cap, dark fur sleeveless vest, bare belly, turquoise baggy pants, red waist sash, orange boots. No page text/frame.
Tarot composition: Three of Pentacles. Actual DQVI Carver, DQIV Ragnar and DQVIII Yangus work cooperatively on a small beautiful stone arch in a bright village. The three recognizable adult men have different practical tasks, checking a plain drawing, fitting a block and steadying a support. Their official costumes remain accurate. Exactly THREE round GOLD coins with embossed five-point stars are mounted in a simple triangle on the arch above them, all three clearly visible and separate. No other coins, decorative coin-like medallions or text. Skilled teamwork and shared craft, no weapons in use.
One coherent illustration, no collage. Absolutely no card title, text, numbers, letters, UI, logo, watermark, outer border/frame or photographed card. Do not add extra weapons or suit objects. Objects explicitly counted must all be visibly separate and accurately counted, with no duplicates or obscured extras. Preserve official costume and clear anatomy.
visual_review: Final image has exactly three large gold pentacles on the arch; blueprint is plain architectural linework without extra coin symbols. Carver/Ragnar/Yangus identity and cooperative scene preserved, no text/frame.

iterations.reason: Blueprint repeated three pentacle symbols, creating visual count ambiguity
